00047 class BufferChannelInternal : public SmartPointer
00048 {
00049 public:
00050   BufferChannelInternal(const unsigned int size, bool zeroData = false) throw();
00051   BufferChannelInternal(const unsigned int size, const unsigned int sourceDataSize, const float* sourceData) throw();
00052   BufferChannelInternal(const unsigned int size, const double start, const double end) throw();

00054   
00055   inline float getSampleUnchecked(const int index) const throw() { return data[index]; }
00056   inline float getSampleUnchecked(const double index) const throw() { return getSampleUnchecked((float)index); }
00057   inline float getSampleUnchecked(const float index) const throw() 
00058   { 
00059     const int iIndex0 = (int)index;
00060     unsigned int iIndex1 = iIndex0+1;
00061     if(iIndex1 >= size_)
00062       iIndex1 = 0;
00063     const float frac1 = (float)index - (float)iIndex0;
00064     const float frac0 = 1.f - frac1;
00065     
00066     return data[iIndex0] * frac0 + data[iIndex1] * frac1; // need to optimise this at some point    
00067   }

00327   template<class NumericalType>
00328   inline NumericalArray2D<NumericalType> toArray() const throw()
00329   {
00330     NumericalArray2D<NumericalType> array2d;
00331     
00332     if(channels != 0)
00333     {
00334       for(int i = 0; i < numChannels_; i++)
00335       {
00336         NumericalArray<float> array = NumericalArray<float>::withArray(size_, channels[i]->data, false);
00337         array2d << NumericalArray<NumericalType>(array);
00338       }
00339     }
00340     
00341     return array2d;
00342   }

00351   template<class NumericalType>
00352   inline NumericalArray<NumericalType> toArray(const int channel) const throw()
00353   {
00354     NumericalArray<NumericalType> array;
00355     
00356     if(channels != 0)
00357     {
00358       int channelToUse = channel;
00359       while(channelToUse < 0)
00360         channelToUse += numChannels_;
00361       
00362       NumericalArray<float> floatArray = NumericalArray<float>::withArray(size_, 
00363                                         channels[channel % numChannels_]->data, 
00364                                         false);
00365       array = floatArray;
00366     }
00367     
00368     return array;
00369   }

00714   template<UnaryOpFunction op>
00715   Buffer unary() const throw()                                        
00716   {                                                           
00717     Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(size_, numChannels_, false));                             
00718     
00719     for(int channelIndex = 0; channelIndex < numChannels_; channelIndex++)                        
00720     {                                                         
00721       int numSamples = size_;                                           
00722       float* inputSamples = channels[channelIndex]->data;                               
00723       float* outputSamples = newBuffer.channels[channelIndex]->data;                          
00724       
00725       while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                            
00726         *outputSamples++ = op(*inputSamples++);                       
00727       }                                                     
00728     }                                                         
00729     
00730     return newBuffer;                                                 
00731   }

00749   template<BinaryOpFunction op>
00750   Buffer binary(Buffer rightOperand) throw()
00751   {
00752     const int newNumChannels = numChannels_ > rightOperand.numChannels_ ? numChannels_ : rightOperand.numChannels_; 
00753     const int maxSize = size_ > rightOperand.size_ ? size_ : rightOperand.size_;                  
00754     const int minSize = size_ < rightOperand.size_ ? size_ : rightOperand.size_;                  
00755     const int diffSize = maxSize-minSize;                                     
00756     
00757     Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(maxSize, newNumChannels, false));                         
00758     
00759     for(int channelIndex = 0; channelIndex < newNumChannels; channelIndex++)                    
00760     {                                                       
00761       int numSamples;                                               
00762       float* leftSamples = channels[channelIndex % numChannels_]->data;                     
00763       float* rightSamples = rightOperand.channels[channelIndex % rightOperand.numChannels_]->data;        
00764       float* outputSamples = newBuffer.channels[channelIndex]->data;                        
00765       
00766       if(size_ == 1 && numChannels_ == 1) {                                   
00767         numSamples = maxSize;                                         
00768         
00769         while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                        
00770           *outputSamples++ = op(*leftSamples, *rightSamples++);           
00771         }                                                   
00772       } else if(rightOperand.size_ == 1 && rightOperand.numChannels_ == 1) {                  
00773         numSamples = maxSize;                                         
00774         
00775         while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                        
00776           *outputSamples++ = op(*leftSamples++, *rightSamples);           
00777         }                                                   
00778       } else {                                                  
00779         numSamples = minSize;                                         
00780         while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                        
00781           *outputSamples++ = op(*leftSamples++, *rightSamples++);           
00782         }                                                   
00783         
00784         numSamples = diffSize;                                          
00785         if(size_ > rightOperand.size_) {                                    
00786           while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                      
00787             *outputSamples++ = op(*leftSamples++, 0.f);               
00788           }                                                 
00789         }                                                   
00790         else if(rightOperand.size_ > size_) {                                 
00791           while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                      
00792             *outputSamples++ = op(0.f, *rightSamples++);                
00793           }                                                 
00794         }                                                   
00795       }                                                     
00796     }                                                       
00797     
00798     return newBuffer;                                               
00799   }
